MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

2. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 23
   D. 19

4. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 18
   D. 11

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

9. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 22

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

13. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 56

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 32

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
